prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t pick one single “best” salon for all people — Columbus is big and salons change — but I can help you find the best option for your needs. A couple quick questions before I make targeted suggestions:
- Do you want UV (tanning beds) or a sunless spray tan?
- Which part of Columbus (zip code or neighborhood) are you near?
- Any budget or membership preferences?

If you want to start looking now, here’s a short, practical plan and what to look for:

How to find the best salon
1. Search and filter: Google Maps and Yelp — search “tanning salon near [neighborhood or ZIP]” and filter 4+ star reviews. Sort by “most recent” to avoid outdated praise.
2. Read recent reviews (last 6–12 months) and look for consistent mentions of cleanliness, staff professionalism, and equipment condition.
3. Check the salon’s website or social pages for up-to-date pricing, services (beds vs spray, high-pressure vs low-pressure beds), and pictures of the facility.

What to ask or check when you call/visit
- Do you offer UV beds, spray tans, or both? (If spray, ask if airbrush & certified.)
- How old are your tanning bed bulbs and how often do you replace them?
- Are techs trained in skin typing and session recommendations?
- Can I see the room/equipment and your cleaning procedures?
- Do you offer a first-timer walk-through or trial session?
- Any package deals, membership fees, or cancellation policies?

Quality indicators
- Clean facility, disposable liners or sanitized surfaces, fresh towels
- Friendly, knowledgeable staff who ask about skin type/meds
- Clear pricing and recommended session schedule (not aggressive upsells)
- Certifications for spray technicians (for spray tans)

Safety tips
- If using UV, know your Fitzpatrick skin type and follow recommended exposure limits to avoid burns.
- Consider sunless (spray) tans if you want a safer alternative — they avoid UV damage.
- Use moisturizer and follow pre/post care instructions for longer-lasting, even results.
- If you’re on medication or have skin conditions, check with your doctor before tanning.

If you tell me which neighborhood or whether you want spray vs beds, I’ll suggest the top salons in that area (based on typical review patterns and common chains) and give a short comparison.
